event: FOMC raises the target range by 50bp or more on 9 December 2026
market_source: none recorded. The lanes recorded only the 25bp hike market (Polymarket 94, Kalshi 92, as reported on 2026-11-25, R20B-16)
resolution_rule: Federal Reserve FOMC statement of 2026-12-09: upper bound of the target range at 4.50% or higher

event: At least one dissent at the 9 December 2026 FOMC
resolution_rule: Vote list in the Federal Reserve FOMC statement of 2026-12-09

event: The 9 December FOMC starts reserve management purchases above zero, starts long-end purchases, or names a Treasury yield level
resolution_rule: Federal Reserve FOMC statement and implementation note of 2026-12-09. Any one of the three counts as Yes

event: November 2026 core CPI, month on month, rounded, 0.3% or more
resolution_rule: BLS CPI news release for November 2026: seasonally adjusted one-month change in all items less food and energy, as printed to one decimal

event: TIC October: foreign official Treasury holdings below September's $3,674.7B
resolution_rule: Treasury TIC Major Foreign Holders table, line 'of which foreign official', October 2026, first print

event: TIC October: Japan's Treasury holdings below September's $1,063.1B
resolution_rule: Treasury TIC Major Foreign Holders table, Japan, October 2026, first print

event: Japan MOF reports zero yen intervention for 29 October to 26 November 2026
resolution_rule: Japan Ministry of Finance monthly Foreign Exchange Intervention Operations release for the period from 29 October 2026 (total JPY 0 counts as Yes). If the release period ends on another day in late November, score on that release

event: Bank of Japan raises its policy rate to around 1.5% or higher at its December 2026 meeting
market_source: none recorded as a point price. Press reports say December hike odds are above 70% (Investing.com calendar and BigGo, secondary)
resolution_rule: Bank of Japan Statement on Monetary Policy from the December 2026 meeting: guideline for the uncollateralized overnight call rate at around 1.5% or higher

event: ECB raises the deposit facility rate to 2.75% or higher at its December 2026 meeting
market_source: Trading Economics report of market rate pricing, about 80% for a 25bp December hike, 2026-11-12 (R20C-28). Rates pricing, not a prediction market
resolution_rule: ECB press release on monetary policy decisions from the December 2026 Governing Council meeting. Score on the deposit facility rate. No December meeting by 2026-12-31 counts as No

event: OPEC+ at its 29 November meeting announces a group-wide cut, with 2027 production levels below those in force for December 2026
resolution_rule: OPEC Secretariat press release on the OPEC and non-OPEC ministerial meeting of 2026-11-29 (opec.org). A delay of the meeting past 2026-12-31 counts as No

event: The French Senate adopts the 2027 finance bill (PLF 2027) in a vote on the whole bill by 9 December 2026
resolution_rule: Senate legislative file for the PLF 2027 (senat.fr) shows adoption of the whole bill on or before 2026-12-09. Rejection or no vote by that date counts as No

event: France brings its 2027 budget into force by ordinance under Article 47 of the Constitution by 31 January 2027
resolution_rule: Journal officiel publishes an ordinance under Article 47 putting the 2027 finance bill into force by 2027-01-31. A special law (loi spéciale) or an enacted finance law does not count

event: France to Germany 10-year spread closes above 175bp on any day from 27 November 2026 to 31 January 2027
resolution_rule: Agence France Trésor daily TEC10 minus the Bundesbank daily 10-year federal bond yield, same day, above 1.75 percentage points on any day in the window

event: Two of Moody's, S&P and Fitch rate France in the BBB band (Baa1 or BBB+ or lower) by 31 January 2027 (conditional C11)
resolution_rule: Rating action press releases of the three agencies dated on or before 2027-01-31

event: China keeps all six suspended export-control measures suspended beyond 10 January 2027, or revokes them
resolution_rule: MOFCOM numbered announcement (with or without the General Administration of Customs) dated on or before 2027-01-10 Beijing time, covering Nos. 55 to 58, 61 and 62 of 2025. Partial extension, general licences in place of the suspension, or a lapse with no notice count as No

event: The White House committee of inquiry holds its hearing on Governor Cook by 31 December 2026 (scheduled for 14 December)
resolution_rule: A Federal Register notice or White House statement that the hearing took place, or reports of it by at least two major news organisations, by 2026-12-31

event: Governor Cook or her counsel takes part in that hearing, in person, by video, or by a written submission entered into the hearing record
resolution_rule: Statement by the committee, the White House or Cook's counsel, or reports by at least two major news organisations, by 2026-12-31. Letters about the procedure sent before the hearing do not count. No hearing counts as No

event: The Federal Reserve Board or the FDIC publishes a final rule implementing the GENIUS stablecoin law by 18 January 2027
resolution_rule: Federal Register publication, or a Board or FDIC press release announcing a final rule, dated on or before 2027-01-18

event: Bank Negara Malaysia holds the OPR at 2.75% at its first Monetary Policy Committee meeting of 2027
resolution_rule: Bank Negara Malaysia Monetary Policy Statement from the first 2027 meeting. If no meeting is held by 2027-01-31, the item is void and not scored
